procedural_matters: ITA 3270 was represented by Tito Arturo. ITA 3346 was represented by Giucio Matanini.
facts: Wind conditions were 6–7 knots, and the water was choppy.
ITA 3270 - inside and clear ahead and ITA 3346 were approaching mark 2P on port tack, entering the zone with a distance of 1.5 m.
When the distance between ITA 3270 and the mark was 1 BL, ITA 3270 bore away and slowed down, ITA 3346 luffed and established an overlap to windward.
When the latheral distance between the boats was less than 20 cm, ITA 3270 bore away.
ITA 3270 and ITA 3346 rounded the mark and completed the race.
There was no contact, no boat took a penalty.
conclusions: ITA 3346 not overlapped with ITA 3270 and not in the zone at the time ITA 3270 reached the zone, failed to give ITA 3270 mark-room, and broke RRS 18.2(a)(2).
